idea-plugin.name: yof
idea-plugin.description:
Security checks for code you write with AI builders and AI assistants. Leaked secrets and made-up packages are marked in the editor when you save, each with a plain explanation and a fix prompt to paste into the AI assistant that wrote the code. Runs the open-source yof CLI on your machine: rules only, no account, no telemetry, and no network call unless you turn on package lookups.

yof attack (Tools menu) tests your own running app with your own test accounts, in the background, after you confirm.

After a check you start: Copy fix prompt, Get a signed report (a report of your app with an SBOM) and Turn on Patch. The last two only open app.yof.io in your browser.

action.description: Run yof check on the project now
Run yof attack against the address in Settings, in the background
Open app.yof.io to order a signed report of your app
